matching_rule: Exactly one specification per planned document ID; no extras.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Controlled appeal cover, people/non-operative counts, trial-to-appeal chronology, grounds, permission, fresh-evidence and order map.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 10-14 pages; 300-500 words per narrative page or 10-22 sourced rows/events per table page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital accessible PDF with stable links, bookmarks and controlled repeated headers.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Missing transcript, unresolved filing date and pending ruling retained across dated revisions.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: No privileged advice, sealed content or protected contacts in open orientation; role variants enforce access.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No copied transcript, generic appeal law, repeated chronology or blank padding.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Historical indictment/count versions, case-management orders, formal admissions, trial exhibit register and witness index.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 16-22 pages; forms/orders at authentic density and indexes 10-24 entries/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Certified/scanned trial forms and orders with born-digital indexes; native exhibits referenced, not duplicated.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Amended count, corrected exhibit number and later-perfected order retained with history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Trial restrictions and personal data persist; appeal expert/counsel receive only authorised subsets.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No full trial evidence reproduction, duplicate forms, artificial witness entries or silently normalised count wording.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: historical record not relabelled appellate finding

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Certified trial transcript extracts with day/session/witness structure, page-line citation and a register of missing, requested, unavailable or corrected transcript.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 35-50 pages; transcript 350-650 words/page with authentic speaker turns; register 8-20 entries/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Certified born-digital or scanned transcript; OCR/search layer verified against image; no generated replacement text.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Inaudible markers, corrected speaker labels, missing session and replacement certified page retained transparently.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Existing reporting/sealing restrictions persist; privileged side notes excluded; page-line extracts limited by role.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No reconstructed missing speech, duplicate days, repeated extracts, synthetic colloquy or artificially widened spacing.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Certified trial rulings, summing-up, jury questions/answers, verdict sheet, sentence remarks and perfected count-level orders.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 22-30 pages; rulings/summing-up 300-550 words/page and verdict/order pages at authentic sparse density.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital certified records and signed/sealed scans; working copies visibly differentiated.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Corrected jury-question transcription and later-perfected order allowed with version history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Reporting restrictions and protected identities carried into appeal copies; public/restricted judgments separated.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No invented directions/reasons, duplicate summing-up, repeated order, reconstructed verdict or decorative court pages.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Controlled privileged-advice register, counsel advice, signed grounds, appeal notice, deadline/extension material, filing receipt and service log with waiver boundaries.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 18-25 pages; advice/grounds 300-550 words/page, forms authentic and deadline/service tables 8-18 events/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Separate access-controlled advice and born-digital signed/filed forms; digital signature validation read-only and logged.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Draft ground omitted from filing, corrected notice, late receipt and expired certificate allowed with history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Advice and instructions restricted to defence/counsel/internal authorised review; filed grounds do not waive unrelated content.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No copied advice into open bundle, generic grounds, duplicate forms, invented filing proof or signature status treated as truth.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Signed fresh-witness account, prior-account search, provenance/contact log, availability record and due-diligence chronology explaining timing.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 12-18 pages; statements 250-450 words/page and chronology/search logs 8-20 events/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Signed statement scan plus born-digital controlled provenance and due-diligence logs.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Changed key-holder detail, uncertain time and delayed signature retained through versions.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Contact/safety data restricted; served statement and authorised chronology available to parties/court.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No coached narrative, invented search event, repeated statement, credibility label or fresh/admissible conclusion.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Vehicle-system source register, native extraction and signature/hash log, expert instructions, report/addendum, calculations and limitations.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 22-30 pages; report 250-450 words/page, data tables 8-22 rows/page and only necessary technical diagrams.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Native vehicle data retained by hash; safe read-only validation; born-digital report with selectable tables and signed declaration.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Expired certificate, unsupported parameter and narrowed offset range in addendum allowed with full history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Defence instructions/drafts privileged until service; proprietary and irrelevant vehicle data restricted.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No raw hex dumps, invented parameters, decorative charts, repeated methodology or opinion on guilt/safety.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Respondent notice/skeleton, record-completeness correspondence, disclosure/scheduling, agreed chronology and responses to grounds/fresh-evidence application.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 15-22 pages; skeleton/correspondence 300-500 words/page and schedules 8-20 rows/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital filed skeleton and schedules; signed/scanned correspondence where realistic; stable record IDs.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Late transcript response, corrected chronology and narrowed opposition retained with history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: No defence privilege; protected trial material follows existing restrictions; internal CPS advice excluded.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated trial narrative, generic safety test, duplicate schedules, copied grounds or party submission presented as ruling.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Permission application/decision, renewal, fresh-evidence application and ruling, hearing record, reserved/oral/written judgment, count-level disposition and consequential orders.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 22-30 pages; applications/judgment 300-550 words/page and orders/forms at authentic sparse density.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital filed records and signed/sealed decisions; draft, oral and perfected versions visibly separated.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Partial permission, abandoned ground, reserved judgment and corrected consequential order retained with history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Public/restricted judgment variants and protected identities controlled; no privileged advice embedded.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No invented reasons, duplicate judgments, generic law, expanded renewal scope or draft outcome shown as final.
